versions.name: Welding
versions.description: Set up a welding process, dress for the sparks, and lay beads, butt joints, T joints and lap joints on steel plate, learning how heat, filler metal and shielding fuse two pieces into one.

provenance.notes: Introduction year (and BSA number where absent) backfilled from the USSSP merit badge history table; for a renamed badge this is when THIS name took effect, not when the lineage began.
